versions.A: The big advantage is that EFT travels. I can tap before a difficult conversation, immediately after somebody triggers me, or when a thought loop has recruited my whole body. It can take the pressure down. I don't confuse that with finishing the deeper trauma work.
versions.B: I can use EFT almost anywhere—before a hard conversation, right after somebody triggers me, or when my mind is looping and my body has joined in. It takes some pressure off. The deeper trauma can still be sitting there.

versions.A: The same principle extends to inner-child therapy: you can know exactly what the younger part needs and still get pulled so far into the child-state that there isn't enough adult perspective left to give it.
versions.B: This also happens in inner-child therapy: you can know exactly what the younger part needs and still get pulled so far into the child-state that there isn't enough adult perspective left to give it.

versions.A: And the child is sitting there thinking, “Big fuckity whoopty doo. What are you gonna do for me?” Relaxation hasn't really affected that awkward, difficult time with the inner child for me.
